425	**W3-10 · SuperDraft Five** — build a starting five where each slot's player pool is randomized
426	(a franchise / country / draft class) under a rotating daily objective: Tallest Five, Most Rings,
427	Most Career Points, Oldest Five. Score = the metric itself; leaderboard percentile decides rank
428	points (top 10% = 100). Produces highly shareable lineup cards. ⏱ 2–3 min. *Data: per-player
429	metrics, pools.*
430	
431	**W3-11 · Pack 5** — 11 player cards left→right; on each, pick which of 5 stats (PPG/RPG/APG/rings/
432	All-Stars) beats-or-equals the hidden next card. Yellow warning on first miss, red = out. 20 pts per
433	card cleared (220). NBA card culture makes this land visually — design cards like premium
434	Panini-style frames in app colors. ⏱ 2–3 min. *Data: comparable stat lines, headshots.*
435	
436	**W3-12 · Slate Predictor** — [reference](../game-research/matchweek-predictor-incl-final-day-score.png).
437	Tonight's slate: pick every winner + margin bucket; each game locks at tip-off; 5 pts winner,
438	10 with margin. Weekly leaderboard; "beat the ghost" celebrity/analyst entry; Playoffs/Finals
439	special editions. Needs a results-settlement job. ⏱ <1 min to enter picks. Mode note: S-only at
440	launch (picks settle against real games, not an opponent); friend leagues (compare weekly totals
441	in a room) are the natural F-mode later. *Data: schedule + tip-off times + finals
442	(`trivia_gameschedule`).*
443	
444	**W3-13 · Standings Predictor** — [reference](../game-research/table-predictor-season-run-in-table-pred.png).
445	Pre-season: drag all 30 teams into predicted final order; 25 pts exact, decaying by distance
446	(500 max); tiebreak = champion's win total. Re-run at All-Star break. Seasonal bookend event.
447	⏱ 3–5 min once per season. S-only by nature (season-long settlement); friend-league comparison
448	later.
449

451	100 seconds: "name every #1 overall pick since 2000" — +5s per hit, 5 pts/answer. Sporcle's 6.8M
452	plays on *one* NBA quiz prove the evergreen demand; near-zero build cost once the alias matcher
453	exists. Daily featured list + library. ⏱ ~2 min. *Data: entity lists (reuses Top-10 data).*
